# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 USD | Reports to Partnerships (GTM-facing function) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s enterprise opportunity depends on making advanced AI useful within organizations that differ widely in technical maturity, governance expectations, data conditions, and readiness for workflow change.

The core scaling challenge is multiplying delivery capacity through an ecosystem while maintaining a dependable customer experience. Partners can extend market reach and industry expertise, but uneven implementation quality can weaken
trust,
slow realization of value, and create fragmented technical patterns.

This context favors a leader who can turn complex customer learning into reusable assets, clear operating standards, and practical guidance for varied partner types.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic presents itself as an AI safety and research company focused on building systems that are dependable, understandable, and controllable. Its public-benefit orientation makes responsible deployment central to its enterprise
identity, not a secondary compliance concern.

Claude serves both business users and developers. That creates a combined product motion: organizations may introduce AI to knowledge workers while also building AI-enabled applications, internal tools, and customer-facing experiences.

The operating model is ecosystem-enabled. Anthropic provides the platform, product experience, and technical foundations; cloud, services, and technology partners help organizations apply those capabilities in real business settings.

A central operating question is how to preserve consistent technical and governance standards while giving partners room to tailor offerings by industry, customer environment, and transformation objective.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Enterprise AI adoption is increasingly judged on durable workflow impact rather than access to a model alone. Customers need confidence that implementation approaches account for technical setup, organizational rollout, user behavior,
security expectations, and ongoing improvement.

Anthropic’s positioning around reliability and control raises the standard for solution narratives. Technical teams must show how these qualities appear in practical architecture choices, evaluation methods, operating safeguards, and
customer outcomes.

The commercial pressure is to turn broad product capability into specific, repeatable paths to value without forcing every customer into a uniform deployment model. A financial-services workflow, developer productivity initiative, and
enterprise knowledge program may share core platform principles while requiring distinct change and solution patterns.

Another pressure point is prioritization. Field learning is valuable, yet customer-specific requests must be distinguished from requirements that can improve the broader product and partner ecosystem.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
This role operates across the partnership organization, revenue teams, product groups, engineering functions, and customer-facing technical communities. It is a coordination point between ecosystem growth and high-quality enterprise
execution.

Key internal stakeholders are likely to include:
- Partnership leaders responsible for ecosystem strategy, coverage, and commercial alignment.
- Revenue leaders seeking credible technical support for complex partner-influenced opportunities.

External stakeholders span alliance leaders, consulting delivery organizations, cloud technical teams, technology providers, customer architects, transformation sponsors, and operational owners accountable for business results.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Claude supports business-oriented work as well as development use cases. The architecture conversation therefore extends beyond application integration to include workforce experience, workflow design, access controls, evaluation, and
organizational adoption.

Anthropic’s enterprise materials emphasize security, compliance, administrative capabilities, and rollout planning. This suggests that technical credibility will require connecting platform decisions to the conditions needed for broad,
sustained organizational use.

Strong ecosystem patterns should make complex AI deployment more approachable without oversimplifying risk. Useful assets may include common design decisions, validation approaches, governance considerations, implementation playbooks,
and industry-oriented solution blueprints.

The company’s emphasis on dependable and steerable systems can become a practical differentiator when it is reflected in how partners design, test, communicate, and operate customer solutions.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic describes an ecosystem that includes cloud, technology, and services organizations. These routes to market have different strengths, incentives, and technical needs, requiring a shared foundation with partner-specific methods.

The ecosystem includes several important roles:
- Technology companies can incorporate Claude into adjacent products, platforms, and business workflows.

Public partnership messaging highlights enterprise deployment, productivity, value creation, and development of new products. This indicates that partner narratives must progress beyond model access toward measurable operating and customer
impact.

A scalable ecosystem will benefit from common technical language, reusable solution components, practical education, feedback mechanisms, and clear expectations about supported product behavior versus partner-specific extensions.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s enterprise-facing materials increasingly address organizational rollout, administration, governance, and implementation alongside core model capability. This reflects a market shift: enterprise buyers expect more than AI
access; they seek pathways to reliable adoption.

As cloud providers, consultancies, and technology companies invest further in AI practices, speed alone will not create durable advantage. Differentiation will depend on whether partners can confidently guide customers from initial
interest to well-governed, useful production experiences.

The urgency is therefore operational. Partner knowledge, technical patterns, and customer learnings need to compound across the ecosystem rather than remain isolated within individual engagements.

Competitive alternatives may include other model providers, cloud-native AI offerings, internal platforms, and consulting-led transformations. Anthropic’s safety and reliability message is strongest when customers can see it embodied in
solution quality and adoption outcomes.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Ecosystem-scale technical leadership across cloud, services, and technology organizations.
- Enterprise AI architecture spanning applications, workflows, governance, evaluations, and adoption.
- Repeatable technical education and solution assets that improve partner effectiveness.
- Translation of field learning into structured product and platform insights.
- Cross-functional operating leadership across partnership, revenue, product, engineering, and delivery groups.
- Executive communication that makes technical choices, business value, and governance tradeoffs understandable.
- People leadership suited to building an accountable, learning-oriented technical organization.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- A strong deployment-learning loop can improve product decisions, partner credibility, and customer confidence.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims, achievements, metrics, leadership scope, technical depth, and partnership outcomes must come from the governed resume/proof graph.

Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 USD | Reports to Partnerships (GTM-facing function) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s enterprise opportunity depends on making advanced AI useful within organizations that differ widely in technical maturity, governance expectations, data conditions, and readiness for workflow change.

The core scaling challenge is multiplying delivery capacity through an ecosystem while maintaining a dependable customer experience. Partners can extend market reach and industry expertise, but uneven implementation quality can weaken
trust,
slow realization of value, and create fragmented technical patterns.

This context favors a leader who can turn complex customer learning into reusable assets, clear operating standards, and practical guidance for varied partner types.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic presents itself as an AI safety and research company focused on building systems that are dependable, understandable, and controllable. Its public-benefit orientation makes responsible deployment central to its enterprise
identity, not a secondary compliance concern.

Claude serves both business users and developers. That creates a combined product motion: organizations may introduce AI to knowledge workers while also building AI-enabled applications, internal tools, and customer-facing experiences.

The operating model is ecosystem-enabled. Anthropic provides the platform, product experience, and technical foundations; cloud, services, and technology partners help organizations apply those capabilities in real business settings.

A central operating question is how to preserve consistent technical and governance standards while giving partners room to tailor offerings by industry, customer environment, and transformation objective.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Enterprise AI adoption is increasingly judged on durable workflow impact rather than access to a model alone. Customers need confidence that implementation approaches account for technical setup, organizational rollout, user behavior,
security expectations, and ongoing improvement.

Anthropic’s positioning around reliability and control raises the standard for solution narratives. Technical teams must show how these qualities appear in practical architecture choices, evaluation methods, operating safeguards, and
customer outcomes.

The commercial pressure is to turn broad product capability into specific, repeatable paths to value without forcing every customer into a uniform deployment model. A financial-services workflow, developer productivity initiative, and
enterprise knowledge program may share core platform principles while requiring distinct change and solution patterns.

Another pressure point is prioritization. Field learning is valuable, yet customer-specific requests must be distinguished from requirements that can improve the broader product and partner ecosystem.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
This role operates across the partnership organization, revenue teams, product groups, engineering functions, and customer-facing technical communities. It is a coordination point between ecosystem growth and high-quality enterprise
execution.

Key internal stakeholders are likely to include:
- Partnership leaders responsible for ecosystem strategy, coverage, and commercial alignment.
- Revenue leaders seeking credible technical support for complex partner-influenced opportunities.

External stakeholders span alliance leaders, consulting delivery organizations, cloud technical teams, technology providers, customer architects, transformation sponsors, and operational owners accountable for business results.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Claude supports business-oriented work as well as development use cases. The architecture conversation therefore extends beyond application integration to include workforce experience, workflow design, access controls, evaluation, and
organizational adoption.

Anthropic’s enterprise materials emphasize security, compliance, administrative capabilities, and rollout planning. This suggests that technical credibility will require connecting platform decisions to the conditions needed for broad,
sustained organizational use.

Strong ecosystem patterns should make complex AI deployment more approachable without oversimplifying risk. Useful assets may include common design decisions, validation approaches, governance considerations, implementation playbooks,
and industry-oriented solution blueprints.

The company’s emphasis on dependable and steerable systems can become a practical differentiator when it is reflected in how partners design, test, communicate, and operate customer solutions.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic describes an ecosystem that includes cloud, technology, and services organizations. These routes to market have different strengths, incentives, and technical needs, requiring a shared foundation with partner-specific methods.

The ecosystem includes several important roles:
- Technology companies can incorporate Claude into adjacent products, platforms, and business workflows.

Public partnership messaging highlights enterprise deployment, productivity, value creation, and development of new products. This indicates that partner narratives must progress beyond model access toward measurable operating and customer
impact.

A scalable ecosystem will benefit from common technical language, reusable solution components, practical education, feedback mechanisms, and clear expectations about supported product behavior versus partner-specific extensions.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s enterprise-facing materials increasingly address organizational rollout, administration, governance, and implementation alongside core model capability. This reflects a market shift: enterprise buyers expect more than AI
access; they seek pathways to reliable adoption.

As cloud providers, consultancies, and technology companies invest further in AI practices, speed alone will not create durable advantage. Differentiation will depend on whether partners can confidently guide customers from initial
interest to well-governed, useful production experiences.

The urgency is therefore operational. Partner knowledge, technical patterns, and customer learnings need to compound across the ecosystem rather than remain isolated within individual engagements.

Competitive alternatives may include other model providers, cloud-native AI offerings, internal platforms, and consulting-led transformations. Anthropic’s safety and reliability message is strongest when customers can see it embodied in
solution quality and adoption outcomes.

- Ecosystem-scale technical leadership across cloud, services, and technology organizations.
- Enterprise AI architecture spanning applications, workflows, governance, evaluations, and adoption.
- Repeatable technical education and solution assets that improve partner effectiveness.
- Translation of field learning into structured product and platform insights.

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.

Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD
